title: Why I’m moving this Substack from daily coverage to deeper weekly work
headings: What I’m trying to build here

passages.text: I need to make a change to how I show up here.
I don’t think daily AI news is the best way to build that kind of fluency anymore. It can help you know what launched. It cannot, by itself, help you get good.
